src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/443c27b9-10a1-4e4c-9171-98e4e851f0da/BA%ED%95%98%EC%9D%B4%EB%9E%9C%EB%93%9C%EC%B2%A0%EB%8F%84%ED%8F%AD%EC%A3%BC%EC%82%AC%EA%B1%B4%EC%BB%A4%EB%AE%A4%EB%8B%88%ED%8B%B0780x440EN.png"][/img][/p][p Game, and Event Reward Claim and Exchange Schedule: 9/23 (Tue) After Maintenance – 10/14 (Tue) 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]🔹 [b]Event Details[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Clear Mission 2-3 (Normal) to participate in the "Highlander Railroad Runaway Incident: And the Train Disappeared" event.[/p][p align="justify"]- The Event Story includes content such as battles, episodes, Quests, and Challenges, as well as reward-related menus like the Prize Exchange, Shop, and Tasks.[/p][p align="justify"]- Sweeps can only be used in Quests.[/p][p align="justify"]- You can get additional repeat rewards by clearing with Specialized Effect Students.[/p][p align="justify"]* After the event period, unused event currencies will be converted to Credit Points, at a 1:1 ratio, and sent to your mailbox.[/p][p align="justify"]* Please check in-game for further details.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Story[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Clear Story episodes to earn various rewards, like Pyroxenes and event currency.[/p][p align="justify"]   ㄴ Clear Story – 01 Central Control Center Planning Office, to get Aoba (1★).[/p][p align="justify"]- Once you clear the event story, you can re-watch unlocked episodes in the Story menu.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/46d17aef-59fd-4fd7-866f-fac184d6f7d2/image.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Quests[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Clear Quests to earn various rewards like Credit Points and Artifacts.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/4ab1862d-6ecb-4afe-9061-237194fad598/image.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Challenges[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Challenges open 9/23 (Tue) 7:00 PM (UTC).[/p][p align="justify"]- Event Challenges only have 3★ and First Clear Rewards. Clearing Challenges more than once will not grant additional rewards.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/267efbe5-dd71-4b93-93f2-4a6bfb52411d/image.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Tasks[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Clear Event Tasks to earn rewards like Titles, Credit Points, Pyroxene, and Secret Tech Notes.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/71b411b5-1860-496f-911f-0dadfe831b57/image.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Specialized Student Effects[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Specialized Students grant bonuses for each event currency.[/p][p align="justify"]ㄴ In the event screen, go to Specialized Students → Event Currency to view the details.[/p][p align="justify"]- The Specialized Effect applies to stages in both Story and Quests.[/p][p align="justify"]- Specialized Effects only apply to repeat rewards.[/p][p align="justify"]- Once a Specialized Effect is applied, it remains permanently applied to that stage. The effect also applies to Sweeps.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/6d3120f7-60ed-432b-8ed0-1220fccb4ab7/EventPlayGuide8461En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/f2b88bf8-7990-4c30-a0bb-06a17b47e0bb/EventPlayGuide8462En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/eee3ffbf-93ef-4182-ada5-4c757a4eaff9/EventPlayGuide8463En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Shop[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Currencies you earn from Story and Quest stages can be traded for items in the event shop.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/d9d8be37-0f53-4161-ae61-5ada45902471/EventPlayGuide8464En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Mini Game[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Use Highlander Stickers to play the puzzle-based railroad construction mini game.[/p][p align="justify"]- Trains run once a single track connects the departure, layover, and arrival stations.[/p][p align="justify"]- Earn rewards by placing tracks on their optimal routes and running the train.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]1) How to Place Tracks[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Place your "Current Track" on an empty tile.[/p][p align="justify"]  * The set number of "Current Tracks" will be randomly designated. This cannot be changed.[/p][p align="justify"]- Use the Rotate button to change the direction of the "Current Track."[/p][p align="justify"]- Use the Check button to place "Highlander Stickers" and position the "Current Track" in a certain direction.[/p][p align="justify"]- Starting from round 7, you can press the Skip button to skip track placements.[/p][p align="justify"]* Skipping will obtain all available round rewards.[/p][p align="justify"]* Skipping will consume the number of Highlander Stickers otherwise needed to place tracks on the remaining empty tiles.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/b6341739-b677-46d5-82b9-25716a047381/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8462En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/09d2087e-72bd-4830-ae85-0d3e741695cf/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8463En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][b]2) How to Change Tracks[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Once placed, tracks can be moved or rotated without consuming additional currency.[/p][p align="justify"]* Select a placed track to swap it to an empty or placed track space. You can also rotate it.[/p][p align="justify"]* Departure, Layover, and Arrival stations cannot be moved or rotated.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/3848ad4e-cfa3-425e-a538-4ca5c16f2050/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8464En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]3) How to Run the Train[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- After placing tracks and connecting Departure, Layover, and Arrival stations, the "Start Train" button will become available.[/p][p align="justify"]  * On certain maps you can activate the "Start Train" button without placing tracks on all available tiles.[/p][p align="justify"]- Press the "Start Train" button to run the train. A speed control lever will appear at bottom right of the screen.[/p][p align="justify"]- Use the speed control lever to change the speed of the train.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/ec528363-b45f-4e2f-8d1d-7e3ce55e583b/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8461En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]4) Train Rewards[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- The round ends once the train reaches the Arrival station. Round rewards and bonus rewards will then be available.[/p][p align="justify"]* You can only obtain bonus rewards that are on the train's route.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/adf085ad-ae90-409e-9c38-395764fdf858/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8465En.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Detailed Notice on Actions Taken After the 8/31 (Sun) Temporary Maintenance
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643295/d5dddefb7c5ae12109ae173a05653ac50056800e.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is Blue Archive.[/p][p align="justify"]We sincerely apologize for the concern caused by the abnormal display of certain content on August 31 (Sun).[/p][p align="justify"]The investigation into the situation has reached its final stage, and we would like to share the details of the incident along with the measures taken, prevention plans, and compensation.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]\[Detailed Notice on Actions Taken After the 8/31 (Sun) Temporary Maintenance][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]■ Issue Overview[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- On August 31 (Sun), it was discovered that certain client environment settings had been altered.[/p][p align="justify"]- Emergency temporary maintenance was carried out from 8/31 (Sun) 1:22 PM – 7:40 PM (UTC), during which the attack route was examined, and security was reinforced.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]■ Cause of the Issue[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- The Blue Archive client checks environment settings from the CDN (Content Delivery Network) when launched. These settings are created and managed separately from the game, but records of external access were confirmed.[/p][p align="justify"]- Some settings were altered, redirecting to 45.94.31.77 (Netherlands), which caused the issue.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]■ Scope of Impact[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Depending on the unauthorized changes, certain content was abnormally displayed (except for specific store/teen builds).[/p][p align="justify"]- Symptoms included abnormal banners, the appearance of Koyuki/Miku in Cafe content, and specific YouTube content being displayed. A thorough internal investigation confirmed no other irregularities beyond these.[/p][p align="justify"]- These environmental settings only affected the client-side content display.[/p][p align="justify"]- We confirm that players’ accounts, game data, and payment information were not affected, as they are operated in a separate database and always revalidated by the game server.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]■ Measures Taken[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Restored the CDN environment settings and urgently blocked the distribution path, restricting access to internal use only.[/p][p align="justify"]- Limited environment setting permissions to authorized entities and added dual-control measures.[/p][p align="justify"]- Reported the incident to KISA (Korea Internet & Security Agency) and are cooperating with the ongoing investigation into the attack and related security measures.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]■ Prevention Plans[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Strengthen controls to ensure external access to services is blocked.[/p][p align="justify"]- Enhance verification procedures before and after environment setting changes.[/p][p align="justify"]- In addition to existing vulnerability assessments, stronger security measures such as penetration testing and bug bounty programs will be conducted across the game client, game servers, and related services.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]\[Compensation Notice][/b][/p][p align="justify"]We have prepared a compensation package for all Senseis to express our sincere apologies for the inconvenience caused.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]■ 8/31 (Sun) Temporary Maintenance Compensation[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Eligible: All Senseis[/p][p align="justify"]- Compensation:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td colspan="3"][p align="center"][b]8/31 (Sun) Temporary Maintenance Compensation[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]10-Recruitment Ticket x1[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]AP x500[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Tactical Challenge Coin x150[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Expert Permit x3,000[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Credit Points x300,000[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Lesson Ticket x7[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p align="center"]Bounty Ticket x7[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]Scrimmage Ticket x7[/p][/td][td][p align="center"] [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Distribution Period: 9/1(Mon) 3:00 PM – 9/8(Mon) 2:59 PM (UTC)[/p][p align="justify"](Mail storage: 7 days, 1 time per account)[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]* Additional details regarding unreceived rewards for players who purchased the Monthly Pyroxene Pack / Half Monthly Pyroxene Pack / 2-Week AP Pack will be provided in a separate notice.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]We will continue to do our utmost to provide a safe and secure environment for all Senseis.[/p][p align="justify"]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: IMPORTANT UPDATES ON NEXON TERMS OF SERVICE(Announced on 8/7)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643295/a045d0d19a5945bc0a3bb1932f22b26e4b9028d0.png"][/img][b]We’re changing our Terms of Service (effective August 14, 2025)[/b][/p][p align="start"]We are changing our Terms of Service to update how disputes with NEXON Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries and affiliates will be resolved.  The changes include a new informal dispute resolution process, updates to the procedures for arbitrations, and a waiver of rights to participate in a mass arbitration. [/p][p align="start"]If you do not agree to the new dispute resolution procedures, you may opt out by following the process described in Section X of the new Terms of Service.  Depending on where you live, some of these changes may not apply to you, as outlined in the Terms of Service.[/p][p align="start"]We have also readdressed that if you purchase our games and in-game items from authorized third parties, then your purchase will be bound by the terms and conditions of such third party.[/p][p align="start"]These changes will take effect when you access or use the websites, games, mobile apps, and other interactive software products and services (“[b]Services[/b]”) that NEXON Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries and affiliates operate for the first time since the changes.  You may review the changes to the [u][url="https://m.nexon.com/terms/304"]Terms of Service[/url][/u] by clicking the link.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]If you do not agree with the changes to the Terms of Service and do not wish to opt out by following the process described in Section X of the Terms of Service, you may not use the Services.  You may terminate your use of the Services at any time by deleting your account.  Unless you opt out as described in Section X of the Terms of Service, by accessing the Services, you agree to the changes to the Terms of Service.[/p]
